title: Medical Director - OneHome
description:
Overview

Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first

The Medical Director relies on fundamentals of CMS Medicare Guidance on following and reviewing home health, SNF, DME, dual Medicare/Medicaid and Waiver requests. The Medical Director provides medical interpretation and determinations whether services provided by other healthcare professionals are in agreement with national guidelines, CMS requirements, Humana policies, clinical standards, and (in some cases) contracts. The Medical Director provides medical interpretation and decisions about the appropriateness of services provided by other healthcare professionals in compliance with review policies, procedures, and performance standards. All work occurs with a context of regulatory compliance, and work is assisted by diverse resources which may include national clinical guidelines, CMS policies and determinations, clinical reference materials, internal teaching conferences, and other sources of expertise. Medical Directors will learn Medicare and Medicare Advantage requirements, and will understand how to operationalize this knowledge in their daily work. The Medical Director works in a structured environment with expectations for consistency in thinking, authorship, meeting departmental expectations, and compliance timelines.

Use your skills to make an impact

Responsibilities

  • Conduct clinical case reviews of requests from members of the Medicare population and report to the Lead Medical Director.
  • Identify medical management operational improvements within the medical director area.
  • Participate in call rotation which may include weekend coverage.
  • Develop collaborative relationships with team and key partners within the Medicare Line of Business.
  • Support Home Solutions as needed.
  • Perform other activities as assigned by the managing Medical Director.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • MD or DO degree
  • Current and ongoing board certification in an approved ABMS Medical Specialty
  • A current and unrestricted license in at least one jurisdiction and willingness to obtain license, as required, for various states in region of assignment
  • 5+ years of direct clinical patient care experience post residency or fellowship
  • No sanctions from Federal or State Governmental organizations
  • The ability to pass credentialing requirements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with analytic and interpretative skills
  • Participate in educational activities by attending required conferences and also create content to lead/teach/present for individual subject matter contribution

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in an inpatient environment and/or related to care of a Medicare type population (disabled or >65 years of age)
  • Internal Medicine, Family Practice, Geriatrics, Physiatry, Emergency Medicine, Critical Care or hospital based clinical specialists
  • Ability to function in a dynamic fast paced environment
  • Commitment to a culture of innovation
  • Passionate about contributing to an organization’s focus on consistency in outcomes, consumer experiences, and a highly engaged team culture
  • Knowledge and experience with national guidelines such as NCD/LCD, MCG® or InterQual

The Medical Director conducts clinical case reviews of requests received by members of the Medicare population and reports to the Lead Medical Director.

Other duties

  • Identify medical management operational improvements, including those within the medical director area
  • Participate in call rotation which may include weekend coverage
  • Develop collaborative relationships with Team and key partners within the Medicare Line of Business.
  • Support Home Solutions as needed
  • Other activities as assigned by the managing Medical Director

Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

40

Pay Range

$223,800 - $313,100 per year

This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, volunteer time off, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

title: Medical Director - Gulf South
description:
Overview

Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first

The Medical Director relies on medical background and reviews health claims. The Medical Director work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. The Medical Director actively uses their medical background, experience, and judgement to make determinations whether requested services, requested level of care, and/or requested site of service should be authorized. All work occurs with a context of regulatory compliance, and work is assisted by diverse resources which may include national clinical guidelines, CMS policies and determinations, clinical reference materials, internal teaching conferences, and other sources of expertise. Medical Directors will learn Medicare and Medicare Advantage requirements, and will understand how to operationalize this knowledge in their daily work.

The Medical Director’s work includes computer based review of moderately complex to complex clinical scenarios, review of all submitted clinical records, prioritization of daily work, communication of decisions to internal associates, and possible participation in care management. The clinical scenarios predominantly arise from inpatient or post-acute care environments. Has discussions with external physicians by phone to gather additional clinical information or discuss determinations regularly, and in some instances these may require conflict resolution skills. Some roles include an overview of coding practices and clinical documentation, grievance and appeals processes, and outpatient services and equipment, within their scope.

The Medical Director may speak with contracted external physicians, physician groups, facilities, or community groups to support regional market priorities, which may include an understanding of Humana processes, as well as a focus on collaborative business relationships, value based care, population health, or disease or care management.

Use your skills to make an impact

Responsibilities

The Medical Director provides medical interpretation and determinations whether services provided by other healthcare professionals are in agreement with national guidelines, CMS requirements, Humana policies, clinical standards, and (in some cases) contracts. The ideal candidate supports and collaborates with other team members, other departments, Humana colleagues and the Regional VP Health Services. After completion of mentored training, daily work is performed with minimal direction. Enjoys working in a structured environment with expectations for consistency in thinking and authorship. Exercises independence in meeting departmental expectations, and meets compliance timelines. Occasional weekends and holidays are required.

Required Qualifications

  • MD or DO degree
  • 5+ years of direct clinical patient care experience post residency or fellowship, which preferably includes some experience in an inpatient environment and/or related to care of a Medicare type population (disabled or >65 years of age).
  • Current and ongoing Board Certification an approved ABMS Medical Specialty
  • A current and unrestricted license in at least one jurisdiction and willing to obtain additional license, if required.
  • No current sanction from Federal or State Governmental organizations, and able to pass credentialing requirements.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Evidence of analytic and interpretation skills, with prior experience participating in teams focusing on quality management, utilization management, case management, discharge planning and/or home health or post acute services such as inpatient rehabilitation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of the managed care industry including Medicare Advantage, Managed Medicaid and/or Commercial products, or other Medical management organizations, hospitals/ Integrated Delivery Systems, health insurance, other healthcare providers, clinical group practice management.
  • Utilization management experience in a medical management review organization, such as Medicare Advantage, managed Medicaid, or Commercial health insurance.
  • Experience with national guidelines such as MCG® or InterQual
  • Internal Medicine, Family Practice, Geriatrics, Hospitalist, Emergency Medicine clinical specialists
  • Advanced degree such as an MBA, MHA, MPH
  • Exposure to Public Health, Population Health, analytics, and use of business metrics.
  • Experience working with Case managers or Care managers on complex case management, including familiarity with social determinants of health.
  • The curiosity to learn, the flexibility to adapt and the courage to innovate

Additional Information

Typically reports to a Regional Vice President of Health Services, Lead, or Corporate Medical Director, depending on size of region or line of business. The Medical Director conducts Utilization Management of the care received by members in an assigned market, member population, or condition type. May participate on project teams or organizational committees.

Overview

Ready to revolutionize education through AI? We are seeking a visionary product strategist to spearhead our Education vertical and champion a mission that matters: helping students learn more effectively through personalized instruction. This isn\'t about incremental improvements—it's about fundamentally reimagining how education works.

As our Head of Product Growth, you\'ll craft the strategic blueprint that unifies our educational offerings into a cohesive ecosystem. You\'ll author our definitive "Brain Lift" strategy document and translate it into actionable roadmaps that make our products work in harmony. This player-coach role requires you to dive deep into critical work while guiding a talented team of Product Owners toward measurable impact.

We\'re challenging the status quo of one-size-fits-all education by building a system rooted in learning science and AI that adapts to each student\'s unique needs. Our mission is proving that education can be simultaneously personalized and powerful.

This position diverges from conventional product leadership roles. Success here isn\'t measured by process management or delegation skills, but by your ability to drive tangible outcomes through first-principles thinking, analytical rigor, and unwavering determination.

Working directly with founders and leading a sharp team, your ultimate metric is straightforward: demonstrable evidence that your strategy has meaningfully enhanced student learning outcomes. If you\'re energized by accountability and eager to tackle education\'s most significant challenges, we should connect.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Craft and Evolve the Strategic Framework: Develop and continuously refine the comprehensive "Education Domain BrainLift"—a living strategic document that synthesizes team insights, market intelligence, and learning science into a unified vision guiding the entire vertical.
  • Orchestrate Portfolio Development: Transform strategic vision into an outcome-focused roadmap that coordinates all products within our ecosystem. You\'ll determine the strategic sequencing that maximizes compounding value and provides the "why" behind every initiative.
  • Lead Through Action and Mentorship: Serve as both strategist and practitioner—running your own rapid OODA (Observe-Orient-Decide-Act) loops on mission-critical objectives while elevating your team through thoughtful review and strategic guidance to ensure cohesive execution across the portfolio.

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Functioning solely as a people manager. While leadership is essential, your value comes from strategic direction and execution standards, not administrative oversight of headcount and budgets.
  • Implementing predetermined strategies. You won\'t be executing someone else\'s vision—you\'ll be crafting the comprehensive strategy yourself, building it from first principles and ground-level insights.
  • Maintaining rigid, unchanging roadmaps. Your portfolio strategy will evolve continuously, incorporating weekly learnings and adapting to new discoveries from your team\'s work and your own investigations.
  • Managing disconnected feature development. Success isn\'t measured by feature quantity but by strategic outcomes that create synergy across products, breaking down silos to deliver unified educational experiences.

Basic Requirements

  • 6+ years in product leadership positions where you personally developed product vision and owned fundamental problem-solution hypotheses
  • Proven track record launching at least one successful product from conception to market—specifically a complete product (not just features) that reached external users and generated minimum $1M in revenue
  • Demonstrated proficiency integrating AI tools into your professional workflow (analysis, research, strategy development, information synthesis)

About LearnWith.AI

LearnWith.AI is an edtech startup that leverages AI and subject matter experts to cultivate a new way of learning. Our unique approach leverages 50+ years of learning science, cutting-edge data analytics and AI-powered coaching. In doing so, we can help students learn more, learn faster, and learn better - and have fun while doing it. We are a remote-first company that hires globally via Crossover.

Working with us

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Overview

Your work days are brighter here. At Workday, our culture centers on putting our people first. We look after our people, communities and the planet while remaining profitable. Feel encouraged to shine and bring your brightest version of you to help us grow.

Workday values candidate privacy and data security. We will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through non-Workday sites or to pay recruiting fees or consulting services to apply.

About the Team

Workday's Managing Partner practice focuses on stewarding subscribers of our Workday Success Plan offering in North America. We serve customers with relevant industry stories, practical value realization from Workday’s technology, and peer learning networks. We act like a start-up inside a larger organization, continuously seeking new ways to help customers succeed on their cloud journey.

About the Role

Workday's Managing Partner practice focuses on stewarding subscribers of our Workday Success Plan offering in North America. We seek to deliver industry stories, practical value realization, and peer learning networks to help customers succeed on their cloud journey.

About You

  • Collaborate with Account Executives and Service Executives to position and sell or upsell Workday product, deployment, and postproduction services into your customer base and ensure maximum value from the product.
  • Own successful deployment of the Workday solution, drive adoption, guide customers in implementing new features, and sell additional services to support their strategy.
  • Participate in sales cycles to support implementation activities for prospects that will join the portfolio.
  • Drive customer self-sufficiency by ensuring customers understand how to engage with the Workday services organization.
  • Partner with colleagues to position additional value through in-subscription adoption, additional subscription products, or activation of offerings from our platform ecosystem.
  • Participate in partner selection for non-Workday-primed engagements.
  • Guide large, partner-led accounts with global complexity (e.g., M&A and divestitures).
  • Create strategic plans across the customer architecture, attend steering committee meetings, and nurture executive relationships.
  • Provide direction and support to Workday and service partner project teams on scope, budget, timeline, and deployment issues; act as the point of contact to facilitate and resolve escalated issues.
  • Engage other service resources to support account planning and feature adoption strategies.
  • Leverage customer relationships for prospect references as needed.

Basic Qualifications:

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You''ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You''ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You''ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You''ll balance help desk tickets and prioritise them. You''ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you''re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You''ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You''ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you''re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool. You write very well, whether it''s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures. A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win. You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is. You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching. You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone''s time. You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical. You''re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We''re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will have a builder''s mindset, be a collaborative partner, influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and have remote work experience.

We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day, including a competitive PTO package and ownership in the company via equity.
  • The ability to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a company that removes barriers so you can love what you do.
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our team is global, remote-first, and spans North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. Please note, due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters, please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

description:

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer to join our growing data team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience designing, building, and maintaining robust data pipelines and architectures on Azure, while working with a variety of analytics and data integration tools. This role will be instrumental in supporting data-driven decision-making across multiple business units by ensuring our data infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and efficient.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows to support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.

  • Integrate data from various sources including SQL Server, Debezium change data capture (CDC) streams, Snowflake, and other third-party platforms.

  • Implement and manage dbt (Data Build Tool) transformations to create modular, testable, and maintainable data models.

  • Optimize and manage data warehouses and data lakes to support reporting, analytics, and machine learning workloads.

  • Ensure data quality, governance, and security across the entire data ecosystem.

  • Monitor pipeline performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure high availability and data integrity.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure cloud services (e.g., Data Factory, Synapse, Data Lake, Functions, Logic Apps).

  • Expertise in SQL and experience with Azure SQL and SQL Server.

  • Experience implementing Debezium for CDC pipelines.

  • Proficiency with dbt for data modeling and transformation.

  • Strong knowledge of Snowflake including performance tuning, schema design, and data loading.

  • Experience working with multiple site analytics data sources (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, etc.).

  • Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, data modeling, and ETL/ELT best practices.

  • Proficiency in Python programming language for data processing.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

description:
Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, and is excited to help end users who need assistance.

You will participate in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You should be adaptable to the evolving corporate infrastructure landscape and motivated to contribute to a fast-moving, execution-oriented team. This role reports to the Director of IT.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer-facing IT support and be the first line of support for employees via tools such as Slack and Jira.
  • Proactively manage Mac endpoints and enterprise environments; procure and deliver technology equipment; own the onboarding and offboarding experience.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and automation tools; contribute improvements to knowledge bases.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools (MDM/EMM) and contribute to IDP/SSO improvements (GSuite, Okta, etc.).
  • Write clear help articles, automate repetitive tasks, and manage incidents to resolution.
  • Prioritize help desk tickets and participate in project work within agile sprints (Jira). Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open source tools and onboarding processes (e.g., Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, Munki, etc.).
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows; knowledge of APIs and system integrations.
  • Experience providing remote support across multiple countries and time zones; familiarity with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Strong communication skills across all media; ability to convey ideas clearly and support others without frustration.
  • Excellent written communication for tickets, email, and Slack.
  • Security-minded with knowledge of PGP and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching); familiarity with OSI model troubleshooting.
  • Ability to self-manage, scope projects, and collaborate across teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS; experience with GAM and CLI workflows.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.
  • Culture fit: thrives in startup/tech environments and embodies company values.

Culture and Benefits

We seek leaders who are adaptable, resilient, and collaborative; a builder’s mindset to create, iterate, and scale IT practices; integrity and accountability in handling confidential information; and experience working in remote environments.

We offer a comprehensive total rewards package starting on day one, including a competitive PTO package, stock ownership through equity, and remote-first policies allowing up to 180 days of remote work globally (subject to restrictions).

We are an equal opportunity employer and value inclusivity and diversity. Applicants may reach out for accommodation requests during the recruitment process; requests will be handled confidentially.

Location and Recruitment Notes

Location: Petrolina, Pernambuco, Brazil. We are a remote-first organization and may contact qualified applicants due to high volume. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response; unsolicited agency resumes are not accepted.

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full-time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar roles in rapidly growing, security-first environments. You will work closely with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholder teams including Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner seeking a supportive environment to grow IT skills and expertise. This role reports to the Director of IT.

What You’ll Do

  • Be customer-facing and the first line of support; own support and provide an outstanding experience to employees via tools such as Slack and Jira.

  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).

What You Bring to Ledn

  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and creating workflows in Okta; working with APIs to integrate systems.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; handling hardware shipping and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across all media; ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically.
  • Strong writing skills for tickets, email and Slack; clear, friendly, concise communication sensitive to different cultures.

Nice to Haves

  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We look for more than operational excellence — a leader who thrives in a startup/tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will be adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth environment; possess a builder’s mindset; be a collaborative partner who can influence across functions with empathy and clarity; demonstrate integrity and accountability; and have remote-work experience.

What We Provide

  • Remote-work opportunity up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a focus on removing barriers so you love what you do.

Equal Opportunity and Recruitment Notes

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. title: Data Product Manager
description:
Data Product Manager

Location: REMOTE

Annual Compensation: $110,000.00 - $140,000.00 (DOE)

The Data Product Manager leads the definition, development, and lifecycle management of high-quality, reusable data products that drive value across business domains and the enterprise. Serving as a strategic link between business and technical teams, this role ensures data products are discoverable, well-governed, and interoperable from ideation through retirement.

You will oversee the creation and stewardship of enterprise reference data, including hospitals, helipads, airports, air ambulance bases, customers, health insurance plans, and payors. The ideal candidate brings proven expertise in research, data management, and governance, along with exceptional organizational and communication skills.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Coordination (20%)

  • Lead the development and management of GMR’s reference data processes, including stewardship, versioning, and golden record creation, in alignment with data lake and analytics strategies.
  • Define data quality metrics, standards, and SLAs.
  • Address data duplication, inconsistency, and fragmentation; develop and enforce data governance policies and operating models.
  • Collaborate with IT and security to standardize data access controls and support metadata management tool implementation (e.g., Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog).
  • Assess data maturity, identify gaps, and implement improvements to ensure trusted, accessible, and well-managed data products.

Reference Data Research & Maintenance (60%)

  • Build and maintain comprehensive reference data for hospitals, customer profiles, transportation providers, airports, and fuel depots to support downstream workflows such as customer experience personalization and automation of eligibility and authorization processes.
  • Conduct ongoing research to maintain a current database of all U.S. air ambulance bases, including key operational details.
  • Develop and implement policies and procedures for data research, maintenance, and change management to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Leverage enterprise data hubs and services for data storage, cataloging, maintenance, and sharing across key applications.

Data Integration & Synchronization (10%)

  • Partner with cross-functional teams—including Ambulance Communications, Clinical Informatics, Revenue Cycle, and IT Data Teams—to synchronize reference data across critical systems.

Data Analysis & Reporting (10%)

  • Develop reports and visualizations for reference data, market analysis, and air/ground decision-making.
  • Analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights.

Qualifications

Education & Industry Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, Computer Science, Information Systems, GIS, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 7+ years in data management roles, including database administration, data governance, master data management, or enterprise data strategy
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, relational databases, and data warehouse technologies, with a strong ability to analyze and validate data quality and lineage
  • Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Domo)
  • Skilled in research, data collection, maintenance, and spatial analysis (GIS strongly preferred)
  • Background in healthcare, air and ground medical transport, or dispatch environments
  • Proven experience developing data products, managing master data, and working with metadata tools and data cataloging platforms
  • Proficient in maintaining reference databases and spreadsheets
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Databricks, Snowflake) and governance tools (e.g., Purview, Unity Catalog, Collibra) is a plus

Why Choose GMR?

Global Medical Response (GMR) and its family of solutions are dedicated to delivering compassionate, quality medical care, primarily in the areas of emergency and patient relocation services. Here you’ll embark on meaningful work that will make an impact on you and the customers we serve. This posting reflects the role and its requirements; no additional site-wide notices are included here.

EEO Statement

title: Product owner pleno
description:
Product Owner Pleno

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Overview

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você será o Product Owner alocado em um cliente externo, responsável por conectar objetivos do negócio, necessidades dos usuários e execução do time de desenvolvimento. Atuará como dona/dono do backlog, definirá prioridades, conduzirá descobertas e garantirá entregas de valor em ciclos ágeis. Espera-se autonomia para tomar decisões táticas e capacidade de representar a Rethink junto ao cliente com credibilidade e clareza.

Responsibilities

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Conduzir refinamentos, planejamento de sprint e cerimônias ágeis com squads multidisciplinares.
  • Priorizar e manter o backlog alinhado ao roadmap e às metas do cliente.
  • Realizar product discovery: entrevistas com usuários, análise de dados, hipóteses e testes de validação.
  • Traduzir necessidades do cliente e stakeholders em user stories e critérios de aceitação claros.
  • Aprovar entregas em homologação funcional e acompanhar métricas de sucesso (adoption, uso, performance).
  • Facilitar comunicação entre áreas do cliente, time de design e engenharia, removendo impedimentos.
  • Entregar apresentações executivas e relatórios de progresso.

Qualifications

Para Esta Vaga, é Essencial

  • Experiência como Product Owner em produtos digitais ou squads de desenvolvimento.
  • Forte capacidade de priorização orientada a valor e resultado (outcome driven).
  • Habilidade prática em conduzir discovery e transformar insights em requisitos acionáveis.
  • Conhecimento e prática com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas de gestão de backlog (Jira, Azure DevOps ou similares).
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita; habilidade para negociar com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
  • Habilidade para gerir relacionamento e expectativas.
  • Perfil generalista: confortável com decisões de produto, UX, métricas e trade-offs técnicos.

Você Pode Se Destacar Se

  • Demonstrar histórico comprovado de entregas que geraram impacto mensurável, habilidade para definir métricas de sucesso e tomar decisões baseadas em dados.
  • Demonstrar proatividade, flexibilidade diante de ambiguidade, capacidade de resolver problemas na prática, construir rapport com clientes e desarmar obstáculos com pragmatismo.
  • Tiver background em análises quantitativas (SQL, dashboards, BI) ou experiência com experimentação (A/B testing).
  • Tiver experiência em produtos com múltiplas integrações e stakeholders.
  • Possuir certificações ou formação em Gestão de Produtos, Design Thinking ou áreas correlatas será diferencial.
  • Experiência de atuação alocada em cliente externo.

Você Pode Se Destacar Se (Continuação)

  • Demonstrar histórico de entregas com impacto mensurável, métricas de sucesso e uso de dados para decisão.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Saúde e bem-estar

Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers
  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber

Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo

Processo Seletivo

  • Inscrição Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  • Bate-papo com People Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.
  • Entrevista técnica com liderança Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.
  • Feedback final Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager in our Explore&Search Team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Consumer Experience team in Product & Technology is responsible for evolving our product towards providing a simple, engaging and delightful partner discoverability experience, helping users start and cultivate their wellbeing journey with Wellhub.

The Explore & Search team's goal is to evolve the Wellhub app's browsing and search journeys providing users with an increasingly intuitive experience for discovering our diverse range of partners and activities, showcasing Wellhub' value proposition in order to attract, engage, and retain subscribers.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Drive the product vision for providing a great partner discoverability experience for our Members and Subscribers.
  • Defined product requirements, actively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders within Wellhub to propose new product solutions as well as to continuously review and improve the current product functionality and performance;
  • Analyze and assess product opportunities to unlock better partner discoverability and value perception of Wellhub's network
  • Build, communicate and discuss your product vision with internal stakeholders;
  • Drive product planning, build and manage high quality roadmaps;
  • Work closely with data, product design, engineering, and data science teams to deliver well rounded, scalable and stunning product features;
  • Define goals, metrics, track, and report their progress;
  • Design and run user tests, qualitative surveys, and AB tests.
  • Analyze product data to generate insights and identify opportunities that range from the end user experience all the way to the Search & Recommendation APIs, from improving the way partners are showcased on the interface to rankings and models.
  • Work closely with the Technical Program Manager responsible for the APIs to ensure planning alignment and smooth product improvements cycles.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Experience leading the product development of relevant consumer digital products, in close collaboration with engineering and design team members;
  • Hands on mindset, entrepreneurial and self-driven spirit with a great desire to make things happen;
  • Analytical and quantitative skills is a must, ability to use data and metrics to generate insights, iterate and improve the product;
  • Strong problem solving - be able to structure problems, prioritize and make pragmatic decisions in unstructured environments;
  • Capacity to identify and connect users needs and business needs, and develop effective ideas to meet them
  • Ability to analyze complex requirements and intricate user flows in order to translate them into simple, friendly and intuitive solutions – with attention to detail.
  • Ability to discuss high-level product decisions as well as technical details effectively when necessary
  • Experience with consumer facing digital products. Marketplace experience is a plus.
  • Experience in managing user facing products that integrate with machine learning APIs, search and recommender systems is a plus.
  • Previous experience in search and browsing product journeys is a plus.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in leading the product development of relevant consumer digital products is a mandatory requirement.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters.

title: Marketing Data Analyst
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Marketing Data Analyst to our Marketing B2B team in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

The Marketing Data Analyst is an embedded analyst position that plays a key role in transforming marketing data into dashboards and reports that drive strategic decisions across marketing initiatives. This role's primary responsibility is to support Insights Managers by preparing clean, accurate, and repeatable data assets and reports. The analyst will transform business questions and challenges into queries and dashboards, ensuring that the data product ecosystem is robust and consistent for others to consume. This key player shapes marketing strategy through targeted data products, identifying opportunities for improvement and collaborating across teams to enable data-driven insights.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Data Preparation: Translate business or insight questions into queries, reports, and/or dashboards, and collaborate with Insights Managers on how we want to give visibility to this data (understanding the “why” and the business challenge)
  • Dashboard Creation: Build and maintain reports and dashboards to monitor performance metrics.
  • Data Governance: Ensure the consistent usage of concepts, metrics, and KPI definitions across our data products.
  • Quality Testing: Ensure data accuracy and reliability in our dashboards by proactively detecting possible data deviations and working with Analytics Engineers to resolve them. Develop new business quality tests for new data products.
  • Ecosystem Collaboration: Collaborate with the Global Analytics team to ensure a robust data product ecosystem and consistent reporting methodologies.
  • Stakeholder Relationship: Collaborate closely with Insights Managers and business stakeholders to understand their needs and ensure analytics deliverables align with their objectives.
  • Live the mission: Inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Degree in Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or related fields.
  • Previous experience with Marketing Analytics, Business Intelligence or Data Science.
  • Proficiency in BI and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Amplitude).
  • Advanced knowledge in SQL and/or Python for data analysis and exploration.
  • Preferred knowledge of marketing technology platforms such as Hubspot, SFMC, Braze, or Segment.
  • Understanding of marketing concepts and user journeys.
  • Strong storytelling and data presentations skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience with Tableau, Metabase, Python or SQL and advanced english are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters.

Follow us on Instagram lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn!

Voluntary Self Identification

Wellhub is committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive work environment, beginning with the application process. We recognize that we are not all alike, and this is our greatest strength. We hire talented and diverse individuals not only because it is the right thing to do, but also because it strengthens our company. We know that combining our diverse cultures, experiences, and perspectives will help us achieve our mission of making the world a healthier place.

Note: The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.

Responsibilities

  • You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.
  • You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc.

  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You\'ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You\'ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You\'ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You\'ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You\'ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you\'re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You\'ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You\'ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you\'re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it\'s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone\'s time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You\'re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS and related environments.
  • Experience with GAM and command-line interfaces for efficiency.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • We\'re looking for a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

What We Provide

  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company.
  • The option to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job.

title: Project Assistant, Abrolhos Carbon
description:
Overview

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY - This position is based in Brazil (remote), preferably in Espirito Santo or Bahia; candidates must reside in Brazil. To apply for this position, please submit your application using this site: CI-Brasil | Assistente de projeto, Carbono Abrolhos.

The Project Assistant for CI-Brasil’s Carbono Abrolhos initiative supports the implementation of the project, with a special focus on activities in the states of Bahia and Espírito Santo. Responsibilities include contributing to the technical planning of field and operational activities related to climate finance projects and carbon credit origination. The role involves assisting in the preparation of technical progress reports, supporting and monitoring the activities of implementing partners to ensure planned deliverables and expected results are met, and helping to engage local partners and final beneficiaries. The assistant compiles and provides information that supports project implementation and collaborates with other teams, particularly those involved in Climate Finance initiatives and the Restoration Directorate. Finally, the role supports the alignment of project activities with the institution’s mission and strategic objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Support the implementation of carbon credit origination and climate finance projects at CI-Brasil, contributing to planning, refining deliverables, and improving outcomes linked to the Climate Solutions Directorate. This includes efforts to achieve programmatic and project goals, covering indicators related to financing, people benefited, carbon, and compliance with social and environmental safeguards.
  • Conduct monitoring and evaluation—both in the field and remotely—of the implementation of different phases of carbon credit origination projects and activities carried out by local partners (planning, contracting, engagement, monitoring, and closure), analysis of technical reports, and input into monitoring platforms.
  • Support administrative tasks related to project implementation and stakeholder engagement across different phases of the carbon credit origination process. This includes organizing events, training sessions, producing outreach materials, coordinating technical visits, participating in meetings, and preparing drafts and records.
  • Project Implementation and Monitoring:
  • Support data collection, organization, and systematization related to participating properties (e.g., registration data, available area, land-use practices, etc.).
  • Assist in consolidating technical information required for project audits and third-party verifications.
  • Ensure spreadsheets and databases are kept up to date, maintaining consistency and data quality for technical and financial reporting.
  • Support the preparation of materials for technical meetings, field visits, and certification or verification audits.
  • Contribute to field logistics for engagement, monitoring, or auditing activities (e.g., scheduling, transportation, materials, etc.).
  • Assist in tracking work plans and timelines, flagging any delays or deviations to the coordination team, especially those related to monitoring activities.
  • Communication and Stakeholder Engagement
  • Support communication and relationship-building with rural landowners participating in the project, answering questions and organizing necessary information to ensure engagement.
  • Assist in organizing meetings, trainings, and workshops with landowners and partners, including logistical support and activity documentation.
  • Contribute to the preparation of simplified reports on the progress of activities with producers and local partners.
  • Help systematize stories, best practices, and lessons learned from the project to support communication materials and donor reporting.
  • Engage with local partners and project beneficiaries through meetings, events, and presentations, helping to maintain stakeholder engagement, especially with rural producers. Support project outreach and engagement during meetings and events as determined by project managers.
  • Participate in field activities related to carbon monitoring (e.g., forest inventories, socio-environmental data collection, and verification of compliance with applicable methodologies).
  • Support the development of specific MRV (Measurement, Reporting, and Verification) carbon reports, ensuring quality, clarity, and alignment with internationally recognized standards and methodologies (e.g., GHG Protocol, VCS, CCB).

Working conditions

  • Flexible, with frequent field presence in projects located in Southern Bahia and Espírito Santo.
  • Involvement in both administrative tasks and field activities.
  • Regular in-person participation required for meetings, field trips, and other activities, both nationally and internationally, including travel to remote regions within Brazil.
  • Preferably based in the project implementation region – Bahia or Espírito Santo.

Qualifications

Required

  • Up to 2 years of experience in carbon credit origination projects, preferably in forest restoration initiatives.
  • Technical and/or practical knowledge in ecology, conservation, restoration, and carbon projects.
  • Experience with project monitoring and data collection platforms.
  • Ability to support and conduct Free, Prior and Informed Consent (FPIC) processes within project contexts.
  • Experience in preparing technical reports and meeting minutes.
  • Strong skills in structuring and facilitating workshops.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and adapt in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel frequently within the country.
  • Availability for frequent travel.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and intermediate English (with the ability for technical communication) is desirable.
  • Previous experience in the non-profit/NGO sector is an asset.

Preferred

  • University degree in Environmental Management, Forest Engineering, Biological Sciences, Environmental Engineering, or related fields.

To apply for this position, please submit your resume and cover letter.

Application Deadline: October 20, 2025 (11:49 PM EST)

title: Marketplace Manager
description:
About the Job


Draiver is an industry-leading self-learning logistics platform that enables vehicle movement planning, coordination, and execution. We connect businesses to transport services and independent contract drivers, providing GPS routing, tracking, digital documentation, and payment solutions in one simple application. Our platform empowers companies to streamline operations while drivers gain flexible access to opportunities.


We are looking for a Marketplace Manager to play a pivotal role at the intersection of operations and product. This person will oversee the growth and health of our driver marketplace, ensuring we deliver the best experience for drivers and partners, while collaborating closely with product and engineering to shape platform improvements.


This is a unique opportunity to manage dynamic multi-country markets, drive measurable business impact, and influence the roadmap of a global gig-economy platform.


What You’ll Do



  • Own marketplace performance across supply and demand, identifying opportunities to improve driver engagement, retention, and efficiency.

  • Work cross-functionally with product, operations, data, and business development teams to design and execute strategies that scale sustainably.

  • Collaborate with product management to define requirements and prioritize features that improve marketplace balance, transparency, and user experience.

  • Launch and optimize new markets, setting up operational frameworks, KPIs, and success metrics.

  • Monitor performance data to detect trends, identify bottlenecks, and recommend improvements to driver onboarding, trip allocation, pricing, and compliance processes.

  • Act as a bridge between marketplace realities and product development, ensuring product decisions are informed by operational insights.

  • Build business cases for new initiatives and drive projects end-to-end, from ideation to execution.

  • Partner with local teams and leadership across the US, Brazil, Mexico, Canada, and other markets to align strategies and share best practices.


Basic Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, engineering, computer science, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in marketplace operations, product management, consulting, or a similar data-driven role.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to structure problems, interpret data, and translate insights into action.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work across countries and cultures.

  • Hands-on mentality with resilience, adaptability, and a bias toward execution.

  • Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, charts) and comfort with data tools.


Bonus Points If



  • You have direct experience managing a two-sided marketplace or gig economy platform.

  • You have technical skills in SQL, Python, or dashboarding tools (e.g. Superset).

  • You bring product management or product operations experience, especially in defining requirements and working with engineering/design teams.

  • You have working proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese.


Why Join Draiver


At Draiver, you’ll be at the core of a global company that is transforming vehicle logistics. You’ll gain exposure to multiple markets, work with a diverse international team, and directly shape the evolution of our platform. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in ambiguity, loves solving complex marketplace challenges, and wants to grow as both a business and product leader.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Overview

Join Ledn as an Information Technology Manager. This is a full-time role within the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team. The ideal candidate will wear many hats, including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.

The role requires experience in security-first, rapidly growing environments, a passion for automation and infrastructure as code, and strong collaboration with Cybersecurity/IT peers and stakeholders across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Provide first-line customer-facing support to employees via Slack, Jira, and other channels.
  • Own the end-user experience, from onboarding new employees to retrieving technology from departing staff.
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (e.g., Jamf, MDM/EMM).
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies, and tools; contribute improvements to knowledge base and automation efforts.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications (Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.).
  • Manage identity and access management, including SSO integrations (GSuite, Okta) and related workflows.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve incidents; balance help desk tickets with project work; plan work in Jira using agile methods and sprints.
  • Define and work toward objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration (e.g., Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite).
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.; experience with open source tools (Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.).
  • Experience integrating SSO into Okta and building workflows; strong API integration skills.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; comfort with hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to explain technical concepts clearly and calmly to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in documentation, tickets, emails, and Slack communication.
  • Strong networking fundamentals and troubleshooting across OSI layers; comfort working in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Self-management with the ability to scope projects, prioritize, and work across multiple teams.

Nice to Have

  • Some familiarity with AWS and experience with GAM/command-line tools; relevant Jamf/Okta/Google Workspace certifications.

Culture & Benefits

  • Remote-friendly environment with global teammates; generous total rewards package, including PTO and equity.
  • Opportunity to work remotely up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • Ledn is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

Equal Opportunity & Apply

You may reach out to the Ledn team by email for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.
